items.definition:
having symmetry
The design was perfectly symmetric, with both sides mirroring each other.

not in equilibrium; mentally unstable
The table was unbalanced and wobbled when touched.

not good; adverse
The weather forecast was unfavorable for our picnic.

relating to climate
We are observing significant climatic changes.

polite; respectful
The courteous waiter made sure everyone was comfortable.

Having or displaying an excessively critical point of view.
Try not to be too judgmental of others' choices.

relating to an organization
Good organisational skills are essential for this role.

allowed; permitted
Smoking is not permissible inside the building.

not controlled or restrained
The fire spread with uncontrolled speed.

not deserving of respect or attention
He felt unworthy of her kindness.

relating to or denoting exercise that improves or is intended to improve the efficiency of the body's cardiovascular system in absorbing and transporting oxygen.
Aerobic exercise is good for your heart.

having or showing a confident and forceful personality.
It's important to be assertive in negotiations.

panting; out of breath.
She was breathless after running up the stairs.

free from anxiety or responsibility.
They enjoyed a carefree summer vacation.

self-satisfied, unconcerned
After winning easily, the team became complacent and lost the next game.

Done without being planned, organized, or rehearsed.
He gave an impromptu speech at the party.

Having existed or continued for a long time.
They have a longstanding friendship.

Relating to or characteristic of mammals.
Humans are mammalian creatures.

like nuts; crazy or eccentric
The cake had a delicious nutty flavor.

old and torn; having a rough, uneven, or jagged edge or surface
He wore a ragged coat that was too big for him.

Relating to or involving exploration or investigation
They conducted an exploratory study to gather initial data.

relating to the heat of the Earth's interior
Geothermal energy is a sustainable power source.

providing information
The documentary was highly informational.

in a line; in the same line or sequence
The code uses inline comments.

so foolish or unreasonable as to be amusing
His excuse was utterly laughable.

temporary; improvised
They built a makeshift shelter from branches and leaves.

threatening; ominous
The dark clouds looked menacing, promising a storm.

relating to or offering instruction in a variety of industrial arts, applied sciences, or technical subjects
He enrolled in a polytechnic institute to study engineering.

covered with long, untidy hair
The old dog had shaggy fur.

sticky to the touch; showing poor taste or quality
The paint was still tacky after an hour.

impossible to defeat or improve
The team proved to be unbeatable this season.

based on personal accounts rather than facts or research
His evidence was purely anecdotal, not scientific.

holding one's attention completely; fascinating
Her performance was absolutely captivating.

capable of being imagined or grasped mentally
It's conceivable that the project will be finished by next month.

blocked or overcrowded
The city roads are heavily congested during rush hour.

empty, bleak, and dismal
The old house stood desolate on the hill.

intellectually obsessive, socially awkward
He used to be quite nerdy, but now he's very outgoing.

particularly effective, clever, or handy
That's a nifty little tool for opening bottles.

demanding someone's total attention and love; showing ownership
He became very possessive of his new toy.

conforming to a fixed or general idea
The movie avoided stereotypical portrayals of its characters.

not anticipated or predicted
The project faced unforeseen challenges that delayed its completion.

not having a signature
The letter was returned because it was unsigned.

not expressed in speech; tacit
There was an unspoken understanding between the two friends.

relating to a budget
The company faced significant budgetary constraints.

rudely brief
His reply was curt and unhelpful.

relating to religious worship or prayer
She spends an hour each morning in devotional prayer.

by invitation only
It was an invitational tournament, so only selected players could participate.

before birth
Prenatal care is important for the health of both mother and baby.

impossible to control or restrain
The child had an uncontrollable urge to laugh.

of or containing water; dissolved in water
The experiment involved an aqueous solution.

affected by or relating to cancer
The doctor confirmed that the growth was cancerous.

(of a material, surface, or structure) shaped into alternate ridges and grooves
The roof was made of corrugated iron sheets.

lacking organization; untidy; disruptive
The police were called to break up a disorderly crowd.

tuneful; forming a pleasing whole
They lived in a harmonious relationship.

causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way
The mischievous puppy chewed on the shoes.

having no name; anonymous
The nameless hero saved the day.

able to be prevented or avoided
Many accidents are preventable with proper safety measures.

consisting of four parts or elements; four times as much or as many
The company saw a quadruple increase in profits this quarter.

Relating to the Slavs or their languages
Russian is a Slavic language.

Involving or denoting a speed greater than that of sound
The jet flew at supersonic speeds.

Difficult or impossible to imagine
The scale of the disaster was unimaginable.

of a very poor quality; extremely bad or unpleasant
The weather was atrocious, with heavy rain and strong winds.

(of evidence or a legal case) pointing indirectly to a person's guilt but not conclusively proving it
The police had only circumstantial evidence against the suspect.

relating to or depending on the context
Understanding the historical context is crucial for a contextual analysis.
